title: Lights in the Empty Classroom
story: The caretaker, Rosa, locked the science room at six. An hour later she saw light under the door. She had the only key on her belt. Rosa opened the door slowly and found nobody inside. The lamp on the side bench was on. A window was open a little, and the blind was moving. She turned the lamp off and checked the cupboards. Nothing was missing. Then she noticed a timer plug behind a plant tray. The lamp was set to switch on at seven for a bean experiment. A note from the teacher explained the timer. Rosa closed the window and left the timer as it was.
